# About this edition {.unnumbered}

This volume brings together Parts I–IV of *Recursively Realized Distinguishability (R²D)* and the addenda listed in its contents. The Markdown files in `canon/` and `addenda/` are the authoritative sources for this edition. The HTML and PDF are rendered from those files.

The September 14, 2026 integrated PDF remains an archival publication baseline. Each document’s distinctions among definitions, derivations, postulates, physical mappings, and open questions remain in force.
